stem: A learner tries to assign sex to very young cannabis seedlings from small differences in leaf shape alone. What is the strongest critique?
choices: Leaf shape is a guaranteed sex marker before reproductive development
Seedling morphology alone is not a reliable substitute for diagnostic reproductive morphology or validated molecular testing
All seedlings with broader leaves are pistillate
Sex can be determined from irrigation frequency
rationale: Visible seedling traits have not been shown to provide a dependable universal morphological sex diagnosis; reproductive morphology or validated molecular methods provide stronger evidence.
